summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of TORUS Phase-0/1 Setup Generator. 17/17 pytest backend tests pass covering phases, daemons, sessions (CRUD + persistence), step/opsec toggles, progress, and bundle ZIP generation (phase + full-mesh with 10 phase folders + bootstrap-all.sh). Full Playwright UI flow passes: dashboard loads with 10-phase stepper + phase-overview + device profile, session auto-created and persisted via localStorage, navigation to /phase/0 shows 8 command cards with copy/verify/bundle buttons, verifying step 0.1 persists and advances progress bar (0% -> 1.6%), phase 8 shows opsec-shortcut, /mesh shows all 12 daemon nodes with detail panel on click, /opsec shows 10 items and toggling all 10 shows opsec-passed banner at 100%, save-profile-btn works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py imports from phases/bundle without package prefix - fine on PYTHONPATH=backend, but consider making backend a package for consistency.
ProfileUpdate expects a full profile object (model_config extra=ignore absorbs unknown keys). Partial profile updates are not supported — may be intentional for Phase-0 but noteworthy.
No pagination/limits on sessions collection; fine for single-user solo-operator scope.
Full-mesh ZIP is built synchronously in request handler; file size is small (<100KB) so acceptable.
seed_data_creation: A few test sessions created in MongoDB during pytest run (session IDs are UUIDs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 21 declared features pass. backend_test.py covers all /api endpoints with status + data assertions + persistence verification via GET-after-write. Playwright flow verified: Dashboard -> hero-cta-continue -> /phase/0 -> verify step -> progress advances -> /phase/8 opsec shortcut -> /mesh daemon detail -> /opsec 10/10 banner -> save profile. Note: Python <3.12 forbids backslashes inside f-string expressions when writing Playwright scripts; use .format or alternate quoting.
